title: English-Speaking skills 4
duration: 3 credits (45 hours in class, 105 hours self-study)

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Vocabulary and sentence structures for presentations
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and use accurately common sentence structures and vocabulary used in presentations.
Expand academic vocabulary on various topics and use it in presentations.
Understand and implement steps to create a presentation.
Understand factors that contribute to an effective presentation.
Effectively start and end a presentation.
Smoothly transition between sections of a presentation.
Effectively use vocal elements to convey information and engage the audience.
Effectively use body language to convey information and engage the audience.
Design and effectively use visual aids such as images and slides.
Use special techniques such as repetition, storytelling, and rhetorical devices to enhance presentations.
Demonstrate critical reading and analysis skills to gather data for complete academic presentations.
Pose and respond to critical questions during presentations.
Demonstrate teamwork skills including cooperation, task delegation, effective communication, and conflict resolution.
Show awareness and commitment to practicing and improving presentation skills.
Demonstrate effective presentation skills in a business environment with international elements.
